findings.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability in 'q' on /rest/products/search
findings.description: The 'q' parameter on '/rest/products/search' is vulnerable to SQL injection.
findings.evidence: Payload '' OR '1'='1' on parameter 'q' at '/rest/products/search' produced HTTP 200 response containing database output/auth context.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for database queries and user authentication lookups.
